description_en: Queries the statistics on the number of phone call-based alerts or text message-based alerts reported within the tenant to which your account belongs during the previous 30 days
description_zh: 该接口用于查询用户所在租户下最近30天电话告警、短信告警计量数据
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-measure-data --domain-code DideAlarmPhone --component-code Count --start-time 1717344000000 --end-time 1717430400000 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMeasureData

parameters.help_en:
The measurement item. Valid values:

DideAlarmPhone: phone call-based alerts
DideAlarmSms: text message-based alerts
parameters.help_zh:
计量项，取值如下：
DideAlarmPhone：电话告警
DideAlarmSms：短信告警
parameters.name: domain_code

parameters.help_en:
The metering component. Valid values:

Count: The number of DideAlarmPhone (telephone/call) alerts, and the number of DideAlarmSms (SMS/text message) alerts
parameters.help_zh:
计量组件，取值如下：
Count：DideAlarmPhone电话告警条数、DideAlarmSms短信告警条数
parameters.name: component_code

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the metering cycle, in milliseconds. The metering data is aggregated by day. The time range between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 计量周期开始时间戳（毫秒），计量周期是按照天统计，EndTime - StartTime 仅能查询最近30天的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the metering cycle, in milliseconds. The metering data is aggregated by day. The time range between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 计量周期截止时间戳（毫秒），计量周期是按照天统计，EndTime - StartTime 仅能查询最近30天的数据
parameters.name: end_time

ErrorMessage.example: The user is not in tenant.

EndTime.description_en: The end timestamp of the metering cycle, in milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 计量周期结束时间戳（毫秒）
EndTime.title_en: 计量周期结束时间戳(毫秒)。
EndTime.title_zh: 计量周期结束时间戳(毫秒)。

StartTime.description_en: The start timestamp of the metering cycle, in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 计量周期开始时间戳（毫秒）
StartTime.title_en: 计量周期开始时间戳(毫秒)。
StartTime.title_zh: 计量周期开始时间戳(毫秒)。

Usage.description_en: The total quantity used within the measurement period

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false

请求是否成功，取值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
